purpose: New field reference from product intent; no old artwork used as image input
prompt: Create a NEW original master character reference for a cozy online gathering game, not an edit of any prior character. ONE small friendly camp companion, full body standing in a relaxed front three-quarter view, centered with generous transparent margins. Design language: polished storybook game illustration, calm clean silhouettes, soft chalky painted fills with restrained texture, thin warm charcoal contours, gentle ambient shading, no plastic shine, no pixel art. Head: a plain perfectly ROUND warm ivory disc, completely blank, no facial features, sized for a circular profile portrait later. Body: compact rounded rectangular teal canvas camp jacket over short ochre overalls, tiny broad cuffs, rounded mitten hands, short dark cocoa boots with visible separation. No pear-shaped body. Head occupies about 40 percent of character height; body and legs remain readable at 60 pixels tall. No hat, hair, ears, lettering, buttons shaped like text, symbols or accessories crossing the portrait area. Proportions should make a clear standing / seated silhouette possible. A friendly little wooden-toy-like companion drawn in 2D, with the clothing deliberately separated into simple shapes. Genuine transparent alpha background. No ground, cast shadow, props, scenery, grid, labels or watermark. This image is the new identity and paint reference for every later sprite, so keep the silhouette clear and the palette coordinated: ivory, deep teal, golden ochre, cocoa.
